_comment: Human corrections to the probe's derived titles, applied by probe.mjs on every run.
Keyed by sourceFile because that is the one field the pipeline never rewrites.
Set featuredRank to null to drop a piece from the landing page without removing it
from the library — it still appears in the full gallery at /creates/work.
Featured ranks are renumbered contiguously after overrides are applied, so removing
one does not leave a hole.

Set "exclude": true to keep a piece out of the published library entirely — unreleased or client-confidential work. Excluded files are never transcoded, never uploaded, and never appear in the manifest.
